description: Track claims keyed by ACTUAL session identity (PID or session ID). DO NOT use placeholder keys like THIS_SESSION.
how_to_use: Use prism_orchestrate:claim_track { track, session_id: <your_pid> } to claim. Keys MUST be real session IDs like 'pid-12345' not 'THIS_SESSION'. compaction-survival.mjs reads this file and matches by session identity.
IMPORTANT: THIS_SESSION placeholder was a bug causing cross-session context bleed. Fixed in schema v3.
